posts.title: RSS is live
posts.description: Timlig now publishes a feed at /rss.xml. Point your reader at it and new posts will show up on their own.

posts.title: The Two-Rupee Voice
posts.description: A full Hindi voice conversation with an AI now costs about two rupees end-to-end — fifteen times cheaper than mid-2024. The model is built, the compute is subsidized, the languages mostly work. What's missing is somebody to write the line item.

posts.title: Sovereign AI in India: A Word in Search of a Definition
posts.description: Walking the AI stack layer by layer — energy, silicon, chips, compute, networking, data, models, applications, governance — to ask what 'sovereign AI' actually means in India, and where the money is going.
